title: Tame finite-index group algebra base change
statement: Let $L\hookrightarrow M$ be an inclusion of finitely generated abelian groups, not assumed torsion free, with finite cokernel annihilated by a positive integer $N$. Let $E$ be a commutative ring in which $N$ is invertible and $\rho:L\to E^\times$ a group homomorphism. Define $\mathbf Z[L]$ and $\mathbf Z[M]$ as the rings with basis $[g]$ and multiplication $[g][g']=[g+g']$, and use $[l]\mapsto\rho(l)$ to form $U=E\otimes_{\mathbf Z[L]}\mathbf Z[M]$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Then $U$ is a finite free $E$-module of rank $|M/L|$, and $E\to U$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. If $E$ is a nonzero complete Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], then $U$ is a finite product of nonzero complete Noetherian local $E$-algebras $U_i$, each finite etale over $E$; the factors are indexed by the maximal ideals of $U$, and their residue fields are finite separable extensions of the residue field of $E$.

source.place: ILO VI 2.2, printed p.72: invertible-exponent diagonalizable kernel in the Kummer chart; unit-group algebra form of this calculation.
